This game is a very special project for us. It has gone through many stages: countless mechanics were designed, reworked, and ultimately left behind as we searched for the perfect fit. Guests came and went, checking out with promises to return, while new ones took their place. Now we’re close to release, and the final result is the fruit of tremendous effort put into realizing our vision of Hotel Tales.

We’re more confident than ever and racing toward launch. Very soon we’ll share the exact release date, and believe us — we’re just as eager as you are. So start booking your rooms and clearing your weekends now!

notes.title: The village of Tulai
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/9b3f30c1ca72c32be4aceb0f097d419915ec5109.png[/img]

[h3]✌️ Cheers to all islanders![/h3]
Have you ever had the opportunity to visit a Tulai settlement? We assume not, because even the most courageous and attractive traveler of Lyndaria has never seen their village. And for good reason: the Tulai are physically weaker than other tribes on the island, so they rely on trickery and camouflage to gain an advantage 🥸

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645200/Lyndaria_The_Court_of_Tricksters_DLC/
[b]But today, we will unveil the mystery for you ahead of time, just before the tribe's deity returns to his homeland. Welcome to the mysterious settlement of the bunnies![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/543ae90c491c00535c1c3df1e7b94f0a8e94b612.jpg[/img]

The Tulai can see well in the dark and are good at hiding, so they live with minimal additional light sources. However, we appreciate visual appeal, so shall we add some color? 🎨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/b10daa96361ecf3d6996495eaa49743e63cbdb57.png[/img]

What else we managed to find out from the sneaky tricksters:
- The settlement is in the steppe, but a complex system of tunnels covers the whole island
- Their camouflage is so good that no one can find the mischievous rabbits' homes unless they lead you there themselves
- There are no signs of productive work here: no cultivated land, no planted carrots. They are too good to work 🤪

That's the end of our tour! The Tulai will wake up soon and kick us out, so it's better to leave on our own two feet than without them. [b]They will only show themselves to us during The Court of Tricksters DLC 😱[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645200/Lyndaria_The_Court_of_Tricksters_DLC/
